skill.summary: Forces offering ELI5 or TLDR options after complex responses. Always present simplified alternatives.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the eli5-tldr skill.
- Automatically offers ELI5 (Explain Like I'm 5) or TLDR (Too Long; Didn't Read) options after complex responses.
- Presents simplified alternatives when responses are lengthy, technical, or involve multiple steps.
- Ensures increased accessibility and clarity by including summary or analogy-based explanations.
- Always active; no user trigger required.
